reference.question: Point M is the midpoint of segment AB, and point N is the midpoint of segment AM. Given \(AB=24\text{ cm}\), find the length of NB (unit: cm).
reference.solution:
Method 1: Successive midpoints and subtraction

\(AM=12\) and \(AN=6\), so \(NB=AB-AN=24-6=18\text{ cm}\).
